title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description:
Given two sorted arrays `nums1` and `nums2` of size `m` and `n` respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays.

The overall run time complexity should be `O(log (m+n))`.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers `m` and `n`.
The second line contains `m` space-separated sorted integers (or blank if `m = 0`).
The third line contains `n` space-separated sorted integers (or blank if `n = 0`).
output_format: Print the median formatted with 1 decimal place (e.g. `2.0` or `2.5`).

starter_code.python:
# Median of Two Sorted Arrays
# Input:
# Line 1: m n (array lengths)
# Remaining lines: nums1 and nums2 elements

m, n = map(int, input().split())
nums = []
while len(nums) < m + n:
    try:
        line = input().strip()
        if line:
            nums.extend(map(int, line.split()))
    except EOFError:
        break
